carousels.title: 3 Fragrances That Make People Remember You a Week Later

slides.name: Opium
slides.copy: Spice, amber, and incense — a scent so distinct it becomes a memory on its own.

slides.name: No 5
slides.copy: Aldehydes and jasmine, worn since 1921 for a reason — unmistakable, unforgettable.

slides.name: Habit Rouge
slides.copy: Leather and citrus with a warm amber base — the kind of scent people ask about days later.

carousels.title: 3 Fragrances That Make People Circle Back Just to Say Hi

slides.name: Perfect
slides.copy: Rhubarb and almond milk over cedar — approachable enough to say hi to.

slides.name: Eternity
slides.copy: Citrus and lily of the valley, clean and easy — the scent of someone worth circling back for.

slides.name: L'Eau d'Issey
slides.copy: Lotus and melon over clean musk — fresh enough to remember without trying.

carousels.title: 3 Fragrances That Make You the Reason Someone's Still Thinking About Tonight

slides.name: Black Orchid
slides.copy: Black truffle and dark chocolate under jasmine — the reason the night keeps going in someone's head.

slides.name: Spicebomb
slides.copy: Pink pepper, cinnamon, and tobacco — a warm, spicy trail that lingers past goodnight.

slides.name: Black Saffron
slides.copy: Grapefruit and saffron over cashmeran — quietly addictive, hard to stop thinking about.
